properties.comment: Sioux Valley Energy has planned power outage information for you. Line workers will be working in your area, Country Grove Estates, this afternoon, November 10th. Your power will be off around 1:00pm for approximately 1 half hour. Again, you will be with out power starting around 1:00pm this afternoon. If you have any questions please call dispatch at 1 800 234 1960, Thank you.
